english.title: Drivers hours - permit driver to fail to take weekly rest after 6 daily driving periods
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), not to take a weekly rest period of

(A)_[45]_
(B)_[24]_

consecutive hours after six daily driving periods ending at **(..SPECIFY DATE AND TIME..) in contravention of Article 6(1) of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A)of the Transport Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
permit the driver of a motor vehicle not to take a weekly rest period
of 24/45 consecutive hours after six daily driving periods

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) See article 6(1) for meaning of 'daily driving period' and article 8(3) for definition of 'weekly rest period' and circumstances in which the weekly rest period may be reduced.
(ii) Where the place of offence is uncertain, section 103(7) provides that offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H3195 and H3196.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), being the driver of **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to have a rest period of **(..SPECIFY NUMBER OF HOURS TAKEN..) after six daily driving periods ending on **(..SPECIFY DATE..).

This did not meet the required weekly rest period of

(A)_[45]_
(B)_[24]_

hours.
